name: open-oscar-server-crash-safe-leased-offline-f3af
instr:
open-oscar-server cannot deliver legacy ICQ offline messages crash-safely. Lease durable message snapshots until the client acknowledges them, preserving established V1 through V5 wire behavior.

Give each saved message a durable unique identity. Beginning retrieval must atomically create a deterministic batch that stays stable across retries and restarts. Bind one active batch to its authenticated session and replay it on repeated retrieval. Messages arriving later remain queued for a later batch.

Commit must remove exactly the batch's messages. Release or expiry within one second must make the complete snapshot available again without duplication or disturbing later arrivals or other recipients. Interrupted transmission, completion-packet failure, or unacknowledged session removal must leave the whole deterministically ordered batch replayable. A replacement session must replay the complete original snapshot exactly once.

Only a matching acknowledgement from the owning session may commit the transmitted batch. Premature, stale, duplicate, or foreign acknowledgements must leave queued data intact. A delayed acknowledgement must not commit a newer batch for the same account. Releasing an unknown batch must return `ErrOfflineBatchNotFound` from `github.com/mk6i/open-oscar-server/state`, exactly `errors.New("offline batch not found")`, without changing stored data.
